shell.changelog:
## 中文

### 功能特性
- **(更新)** 自更新重写为后台流程：启动后定时检查，自动下载并校验文件大小、SHA-256、文件版本与 x64 结构，完成后提示重启资源管理器生效
- **(更新)** 新版本注入后反复崩溃时自动回滚到上一版 `shell.dll`，并把该版本记为坏版本、不再自动���级
- **(更新)** 注入器纳入更新链路：旧的注册表与计划任务启动项自动迁移到规范安装位置，由它接管后续注入
- **(配置)** 设置页按 Fluent 设计重写，主题与动画可直接预览，数值项改用滑杆编辑
- **(诊断)** 用日志页和问题页取代调试控制台，可查看分级日志、配置覆盖项与脚本 / 运行时问题
- **(脚本)** 新增文件与文件夹占用查询，可列出占用进程、结束进程，并支持一次性批量判断
- **(脚本)** 自绘控件可参与菜单键盘导航：获得焦点、接收按键、拿到焦点变化回调，选中行自动滚入视野
- **(脚本)** 控件能力扩展：暴露绝对坐标与鼠标指针样式，新增位图图标控件，菜单尺寸可统计原生菜单项，菜单项支持显隐
- **(脚本)** `flex` 支持 `on_key_down`、换行、最小尺寸、`align-self`、滚动条样式与文本省略号
- **(菜单)** 输入框聚焦时由菜单窗口接管键盘以支持输入法，关闭后归还焦点；回车直接激活首个可见项，嵌入控件首帧即可聚焦
- **(渲染)** 菜单、任务栏、注入器与 JS 控件迁移到事件驱动的 breeze-ui，空闲时不再持续重绘
- **(配置)** 字体改为按字体族名配置并支持回退链与彩色 emoji，新增 `font.locale`（默认优先中���）
- **(配置)** 支持用 `BREEZE_DATA_DIR` 环境变量重定向数据目录

### 问题修复
- **(菜单)** 修复「发送到」子菜单空白，以及菜单里多出用户目录项
- **(菜单)** 修复滚轮与触控板消息被投给焦点窗口后菜单无法滚动
- **(菜单)** 修复掉帧时悬停子菜单瞬间弹出，以及自绘菜单定位时跳到屏幕顶端
- **(菜单)** 修复自绘菜单项的位图图标丢失与背景半透明
- **(菜单)** 菜单文本清理零宽字符，不再出现缺字形方块，非法 UTF-16 也不再抛异常
- **(兼容)** 修复 OneCommander 新建文件夹被重复触发
- **(兼容)** ExplorerFrame 补丁改为只走经典菜单判定并跳过不可读引用，失败时给出告警
- **(兼容)** 不支持 host backdrop 的系统回退到 DWM 亚克力，不再出现空白背景
- **(稳定性)** 菜单 hook 的异常不再逃逸到资源管理器，键盘 hook 异常时正确释放，卸载时还原所有打过的补丁
- **(稳定性)** 修复异步回调与定时器跨线程拷贝引起的崩溃，重复定时器不再丢失回调
- **(稳定性)** 恢复崩溃上报，并由 `shell.dll` 自己记录崩溃归因
- **(配置)** 首次运行不再强制打开调试控制台，配置重载出错不再拖垮文件监视线程，用户目录变量缺失时自动回退
- **(渲染)** 渲染目标初始化失败时跳过本次显示，不再崩溃

### 代码重构
- **(脚本)** JS 控件回调改为脱离渲染循环派发，同时跳过全透明的填充

### 构建系统
- **(构建)** 固定 reflect-cpp 版本以规避 clang-cl 22 的编译 ICE，并让 sentry-native 不再把新增警告当成错误
- **(依赖)** 升级 breeze-js 与 breeze-ui 到最新版本

### 杂项
- **(版本)** 版本号更新

---

## English

### Features
- **(update)** Self-update is now a background flow: it checks periodically after startup, downloads and verifies every build (size, SHA-256, file version, x64 image), and offers to restart Explorer once it is in place
- **(update)** If a freshly installed build keeps crashing, the previous `shell.dll` is restored automatically and that version is never auto-installed again
- **(update)** The injector is part of the update too: legacy Run-key and scheduled-task entries are migrated to the canonical install location, which takes over injection from then on
- **(settings)** Settings pages rebuilt on a Fluent design system: themes and animations preview live, and numeric fields use sliders
- **(diagnostics)** The debug console is replaced by a log page and a problems page covering leveled logs, config overrides, and script/runtime issues
- **(script)** New file and folder in-use query: list the processes holding a path, terminate them, or ask once for a whole batch
- **(script)** Custom widgets can join menu keyboard navigation: they take focus, receive keys, get focus/blur callbacks, and the selected row scrolls into view
- **(script)** More for widgets: absolute coordinates and cursor styles, a bitmap icon widget, native item counts in menu sizing, and per-item visibility
- **(script)** `flex` supports `on_key_down`, wrapping, min sizes, `align-self`, scrollbar styling, and text ellipsis
- **(menu)** When an input field is focused the menu window takes over the keyboard so IME works, and hands focus back on close; Enter activates the first visible item, and embedded widgets are focusable from the first frame
- **(render)** Menus, taskbar, injector and JS widgets moved to the event-driven breeze-ui and no longer redraw while idle
- **(config)** Fonts are configured by family name with a fallback chain and color emoji; new `font.locale`, defaulting to Chinese-first glyphs
- **(config)** `BREEZE_DATA_DIR` can redirect the data directory

### Fixes
- **(menu)** Fixed the empty "Send to" submenu and stray user-folder entries in the menu
- **(menu)** Fixed menus ignoring scrolling when wheel and touchpad messages go to the focused window
- **(menu)** Fixed submenus popping open instantly when frames drop, and self-drawn menus jumping to the top of the screen
- **(menu)** Fixed bitmap icons disappearing from custom menu items and rendering semi-transparent
- **(menu)** Menu text is stripped of zero-width characters so no more missing-glyph boxes appear, and malformed UTF-16 no longer throws
- **(compat)** Fixed OneCommander creating a new folder twice
- **(compat)** The ExplorerFrame patch now only takes the classic-menu path and skips unreadable references, warning instead of failing silently
- **(compat)** Systems without host backdrop support fall back to DWM acrylic instead of showing an empty background
- **(stability)** Exceptions from menu hooks no longer escape into Explorer, keyboard hooks are released on error, and every patched call site is restored on unload
- **(stability)** Fixed crashes caused by async callbacks and timers being copied across threads, and repeating timers keep their callback
- **(stability)** Crash reporting is back, and `shell.dll` now records its own crash attribution
- **(config)** First run no longer forces the debug console open, config reload errors no longer take down the file watcher, and a missing user-profile variable falls back gracefully
- **(render)** A failed render target init now skips that draw instead of crashing

### Code Refactoring
- **(script)** Widget callbacks are dispatched off the render loop, and fully transparent fills are skipped

### Build System
- **(build)** Pinned reflect-cpp to dodge a clang-cl 22 ICE, and stopped sentry-native from treating its new warnings as errors
- **(deps)** Bumped breeze-js and breeze-ui to their latest revisions

### Chores
- **(version)** Version bump
